title: IPEX Quality vision
content:
This is currently a work in progress model of how IPEX will be defining quality in the future. Putting it out in Confluence as WIP since I have started to refer to this model in very many of my discussions. None of the metrics defined have been set in stone in any way. (end of disclaimer)
